newsitem.title: EGYPT: Three drunks taken off Gulf Air flight.
newsitem.headline: Three drunks taken off Gulf Air flight.

text.p: Egyptian authorities removed three Arab men from a Gulf Air plane because they were drunk, a Cairo airport official said on Sunday.
Reuters on Saturday quoted airport sources as erroneously saying the three were Bahrainis.
"The passengers are Arabs but not Bahrainis," Brigadier Mohamed el-Harthi, director of inspection at the airport's terminal number two, told Reuters.
The Gulf Air plane was flying from Bahrain to Casablanca. The captain of the plane took advantage of a stopover in Cairo to report the three passengers and ask for their removal, the sources said.
In Manama, a Bahraini government official criticised Reuters for "naming Bahrain in the issue."
"No Bahraini on the reported flight of Gulf Air has faced a problem of that kind," the official said in a statement.
A Gulf Air official also denied the three passengers were Bahrainis or that they were pulled out of the plane.
"The report is totally baseless. The three passengers were not Bahrainis and they, themselves, asked to disembark in Cairo," an official from the Bahrain-based airline told Reuters.
